title: Rain Dogs
notes:
Label and pressing variation, black Island labels with yellow/blue "i" logo and blue line around label rim. 

Pressed by [l=Specialty Records Corporation] per "SP" in label matrix numbers, embossed "E A S T" on B side label, and "SRC" logo stamped in runouts. Remainder of runouts etched, mastering stamped.

Includes printed paper inner sleeve with lyrics and credits.

Catalog number 90299-1 on back cover, labels, inner sleeve.
Catalog number 7 90299-1 on spine.

From rear cover:
Written and produced by Tom Waits
Distributed by Atco Records, 
Division of Atlantic Recording Corporation.,
A Warner Communications Company
75 Rockefeller Plaza, New York, New York 10019
*TM owned by Antilles Communications Ltd.
℗ © 1985 Island Records, Inc. Printed in U.S.A.
Photograph by Robert Frank 1985

From inner sleeve:
Dedicated to Kathleen.
Written and produced by Tom Waits except Hang Down Your Head written by Kathleen Brennan and Tom Waits.

From labels:
All songs written by Tom Waits except Hang Down Your Head written by Kathleen Brennan and Tom Waits.
℗ 1985 Island Records, Inc.
Rim text: Island Records, Inc. *TM owned by Antilles Communications Ltd. Dist. by Atlantic Recording Corp. 75 Rockefeller Plaza, NY, NY A Warner Communications Company

Recorded at RCA Studios. Mixed at Quadrasonic Studio, and RPM Studio. Mastered at Masterdisk.

identifiers.description: Side B, embossed around center hole
